EARLIER SCENES (context only):
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。
孟子想，难怪我们常常搬家，原来我妈妈很忙。可是常常搬家害得孟子很难找到朋友。每次搬家孟子也觉得新的地方不是太热就是太冷，不是太大就是太小。在哪的地方，他都不高兴。孟子想帮助妈妈祭拜，可是他六岁，所以不能祭拜。
CURRENT SCENE:
四年后，孟子开始帮妈妈祭拜。他画画很厉害，他越来越喜欢祭拜，所以他祭拜不是想帮妈妈工作，而是他很喜欢画画。孟子成为很著名的古代画家。今天很多中国人很喜欢孟子。

[P84] 【他】越来越喜欢祭拜
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [-他]越来越喜欢祭拜 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): [+就]开始祭拜 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 而是[-他]祭拜
  her past correction (redundant_words): 因为[-他们]觉得祭拜有很多好处 — her note: redundant
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.

[P85] 所以【他】祭拜不是想帮妈妈工作

  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card ambiguous_pronoun: Use 他/她/它/他们 only when it is clear who or what they refer to. If more than one person or thing is possible, repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase. Not an error: A pronoun is fine when its referent is close and unambiguous. Do not use 你 for a story character when it refers to the reader instead.

In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.

[P87] 而是他很喜欢【画画】

In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card not_but_refutation: Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence that genuinely corrects a mistaken or conventional idea with an unexpected alternative. Do not use this pattern merely to connect two unrelated actions, places, or ideas.

[P88] 孟子成为【^】很著名的古代画家

  rule card incorrect_story_information: Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information. Not an error: Do not flag a word or sentence under this rule only because of grammar or vocabulary. Flag it here when it changes or adds a fact in the traditional story.
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.
